tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building house the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.

Last night I cried for several hours for a multitude of reasons. Most pressing was that my girlfriend's dog is dying. We gave her a shower and I took lots of pictures and videos of her. I don't have the same attachment to her as my girlfriend does, but even for the few years she's been a part of my life, she's left an impact on me that I will miss dearly.
